name: Tone.io
description: Create labeled color swatches and recolor photos. Browser APIs share the manual UI rendering paths.

capabilities.name: swatch
capabilities.output: image.url is a relative HTTP PNG download URL. image.dataUrl is the browser-rendered PNG data URL. Also includes mimeType, width, height, options. Server and browser font rasterization can differ.

capabilities.name: photo-recolor
capabilities.instructions: Await ready(), load a Blob or data:image URL, configure and select source pixels, then await export(). Save the returned dataUrl. Processing is local.

capabilities.name: direct-png
capabilities.output: image/png bytes with an attachment filename; download directly over HTTPS. Same recipe options as /customize. Arial/Helvetica/sans-serif use bundled Liberation Sans; Google Fonts load on the server. Other system fonts use Noto substitutes.
